adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined as `z.object({ access_token: z.string(), [z.string().toString()]: z.number(), [z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional() })`. The computed keys use `z.string().toString()` which evaluates to a concrete string at runtime (not a pattern/catch-all), making those properties literal required/optional fields rather than “any numeric expiry field” / “allow other properties” as the comments claim. This means `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)` will not behave as intended and will likely fail for real token responses when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is set, causing the function to throw.
